answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. What survives to the velvet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The onyx holds work receipts rather than names, so the sparrow of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on invitation quota tree, re-queued for a second panel, idle agents bleed standing.
